basic_details.job_title: NAM Thrissur Yoga Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur (NAM Thrissur) has announced vacancy for the Yoga Instructor post on a contract basis. Candidates holding a BNYS/BAMS degree OR MSc/MPhil (Yoga) OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Yoga from recognized university/board can apply offline by submitting their application directly or through post to the District Programme Manager, DPMSU on or before 19 October 2026. The notified pay for the post is 14,000/-. Eligible applicants must attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualifications, and address, along with an active mobile number and email ID. Th

content_sections.heading: NAM Thrissur Yoga Instructor at a Glance

rows.details: BNYS / BAMS / MSc (Yoga) / MPhil (Yoga) or equivalent with specific diploma/certificate

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in a sealed envelope directly or through post to the following address: District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National AYUSH Mission, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital Campus, Palace Road, Patturaikkal, Thrissur, PIN: 680 022 The cover containing the application should be superscribed as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF" (NAME OF THE POST). Applications accepted only on working days from 10 AM to 5 PM. Applications received after 5 PM on 19/10/2026 will be summarily rejected. Applications through E-mail will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed a BNYS/BAMS degree OR MSc (Yoga) / MPhil (Yoga) from a government-recognized university. Alternatively, candidates must hold a Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Yoga from a government-recognized university, or a one-year PG Diploma/Certificate course in Yoga recognized by the government or government departments, or a YCB (Yoga Certification Board/SCOLE Kerala) Diploma in Yogic Sciences and Sports Yoga/Certificate course in Yoga (with a duration of not less than one year). Candidates from the State Resource Centre must have passed a one-year Yoga Teacher Training Course (D.Vett.Course). Age Limit: Age limit is 40 years as the maximum age limit (below 40 years of age).

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification, and address Self-attested copies of certificates proving working experience at National AYUSH Mission district ayurveda hospital Equivalency certificate if applicable

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of recruitment shall be an interview. If there are 20 or more applicants, a written test will be conducted along with the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for NAM Thrissur Yoga Instructor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Yoga Instructor post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 19-10-2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BNYS/BAMS degree, MSc/MPhil in Yoga, or a recognized degree, diploma, or certificate in Yoga as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years (below 40 years).

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly pay for the Yoga Instructor?
faq.answer: The notified consolidated monthly pay is 14,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled applications offline either directly or through post to the District Programme Manager, DPMSU, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an interview. A written test will be conducted if there are 20 or more applicants.

faq.question: Q9. What is the date of the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 26-10-2026 at 10.30 AM at the National AYUSH Mission District Programme Manager Office, Thrissur.

faq.question: Q10. Is the appointment permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a contract basis under National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur.
